Who we are

An amalgamation built for scale

Mpangazitha Pty Ltd is a multi-disciplinary engineering company formed through the amalgamation of three established South African businesses, uniting specialist skills across Civil, Building, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering under one banner.

Headquartered across Gauteng and Mpumalanga, we've executed projects for municipal, provincial and national clients throughout South Africa and neighbouring countries — entering the market not as a startup, but as a genuinely established force.

“Integrity, innovation and quality are the cornerstone of our operational culture and business approach.”

Our baseline motto across every discipline: “If it is not safe, don’t execute.”

MPANGAZITHA SAFETY & ENVIRONMENTAL POLICY
What we do

Four disciplines, one accountable team

01 · Civil Engineering & Infrastructure

The structural backbone of every project

Our largest and most established division, responsible for the concrete, water and road infrastructure that underpins economic growth.

  • All forms of concrete structural work
  • Sewer and water reticulation systems
  • Road condition surveys and safety audits
  • Roads construction, maintenance and rehabilitation
02 · General Building Construction

From ground-up builds to ongoing upkeep

Residential, commercial and industrial building work, delivered with the same discipline and quality control at every scale.

  • Residential construction, low cost and bonded
  • Commercial and industrial building construction
  • Rehabilitation and maintenance across all three
03 · Mechanical Engineering

Keeping plants and fleets running

From routine servicing to full installations, our mechanical teams support live sites without interrupting operations.

  • Mechanical installations and maintenance
  • Plant and equipment services
  • Mechanical project management
04 · Electrical Engineering

From substations to trackside power

Qualified, safety-first teams supporting new-build projects and ongoing operations across a wide range of electrical infrastructure.

  • Electrical installations and maintenance
  • Substations and distribution systems
  • Electrical project management
